description: Election Commission - Declare that Mr. A. R. A. Kumara of  the Nuwaraeliya Municipal Council has vacated his office
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Nuwara Eliya Municipal Council has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a direct matter concerning electoral processes and the status of an elected official under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, fitting the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for content related to electoral matters, candidate registrations, and declarations about the status of elected members.
